question: In Indian children aged 5–18 years, obesity is defined as a BMI-for-age at or above the 95th percentile on the IAP 2015 reference charts, while overweight is defined as BMI-for-age at or above the 85th but below the 95th percentile.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The IAP 2015 charts use the 85th percentile for overweight and 95th percentile for obesity in children 5–18 years. Adult cut-offs (≥25/≥30 kg/m²) are NOT used for children.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. IAP 2015 defines overweight as BMI-for-age ≥85th percentile and obesity as BMI-for-age ≥95th percentile in Indian children 5–18 years. These are the clinically applicable thresholds in Indian practice, not the adult BMI cut-offs.
